name: wisecat-moodle-dev
description: Moodle plugin and theme development for Moodle 5.2 and 5.3: 28 skills, 11 slash commands and 2 subagents. Seven theme skills (Boost child themes, SCSS and dark mode, layouts and templates, renderers, settings, testing and release) and plugin skills for scaffolding, XMLDB, web services, hooks, JavaScript, PHPUnit, Behat, CI, security, privacy, performance, accessibility, the Moodle app, upgrades, release, Marketplace listings, language packs and walkthroughs with screenshots. Adapters for Cursor, Copilot, Aider and Continue.
